result.summary: The image shows a typical urban residential street with row houses and narrow sidewalks on both sides. While sidewalks are present, the environment lacks marked crossings, traffic calming measures, and clear lane markings, relying on parked cars for a minimal buffer.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs where cars are parked.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible, forcing pedestrians to cross the street without a designated or protected space.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash bins and debris on the sidewalk narrow the already limited walking space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic in this residential area.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street lined with brick row houses and parallel parked cars on both sides. A continuous concrete sidewalk is present, but it lacks a buffer from the roadway, street trees, or pedestrian-scale lighting.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Dense parallel parking on both sides of the street limits sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who may attempt to cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the frame.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lamps or pedestrian-scale lighting are present, which may reduce safety and security for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, improve the microclimate, and naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.
